Introduction

Today's story is quiet, but very strong.

It happens in Los Angeles, California.

It is about a veteran named John Follmer and an old Japanese garden.

The garden was messy and almost hidden.

John did not walk away.

He started to clean it with other veterans.

As you listen, try these small tasks.

Say yes or no in your head.

Choose this or that.

And sometimes, guess what happens next.

This helps your English grow step by step.

Ready?

Let's go to the garden.

Visit ovi english dot com for the transcript and practice.

Summary

Nice work today. Before we say one new word from the story. Maybe or path. Now say one fact. For example: John Follmer helped an old Or: Other with him. This is a great way to practice speaking. One word. One fact. Simple and Practice more at ovi english dot com with today's lesson and quiz.

Practice

Is the story set in Los Angeles?

Yes, it is.

Did John find an old garden or a new garden?

He found an old garden.

What does volunteer mean?

It means a person who helps without pay.

Name two jobs the volunteers did.

They pulled weeds and cleared paths.

Why did the garden matter to veterans?

It gave them a calm place and useful work together.

Summary

Nice work today.

Before we finish, say one new word from the story.

Maybe volunteer, restore, campus, or path.

Now say one fact.

For example: John Follmer helped restore an old Japanese garden.

Or: Other veterans worked with him.

This is a great way to practice speaking.
